decisions.reason: A safety shoe line is core business for this large in-house manufacturer, and with no evidence of a shortfall against aspirations and ample slack, there is no trigger for problemistic search.
A comfort insole is a low-cost accessory that complements the core footwear range, and organisational slack lets the firm carry it while its results remain uncertain.
The supportive insole fits the firm's foot-measurement and tailored-solutions offering, and only a mention on the website gives no sign of an aspiration shortfall that would justify dropping it.
Featured on its own dedicated page, the ergonomic series appears to meet aspirations and matches the firm's innovation strategy, so there is little reason to search for alternatives.
Firefighter boots are a more specialised niche with somewhat greater uncertainty, but the firm's slack and flexible production allow it to keep carrying them.
Placement on the home page signals strong management commitment and satisfactory results, making removal unlikely.
